title: Safe, Healthy, Adolescent Relationships and Peers
brief_summary: The Safe, Healthy, Adolescent Relationships and Peers study seeks to understand some of the factors that contribute to the behaviors and health of teen girls, such as girl's friendships, their dating behaviors, their risk-taking behaviors, and their knowledge about how to make healthy choices. This study will inform us on ways to help teen girls engage in safe and healthy relationships and adjustment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* reside in Lane County and within 70 miles of the University of Oregon
* have a current caregiver
* both girl and caregiver are fluent in English

Exclusion Criteria:

* are medically fragile
* have a significant developmental disability
* have graduated from high school or have a General Educational Diploma (GED)
